MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  July 1, 2019

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills
  Estates, CA 90274, by CHAIR ZIGRANG.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR led those assembled in the salute to the flag

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONER’S PRESENT:  Schachter, Medawar, Zigrang, Carman, Yoo, Edler

  COMMISSIONER’S ABSENT:  Scott

  STAFF PRESENT:  Planning Director Wahba
  Senior Planner Naughton
  Administrative Assistant Corea

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF MAY 6, 2019

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO
  to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF MAY 6,
  2019

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  B.  2019 SEMI-ANNUAL CODE COMPLIANCE REPORT

  COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVED THE CONSENT CALENDAR, WHICH INCLUDES ITEMS 6-A AND
  6-B

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-09-19; APPLICANT: ED BOOTH; LOCATION: 6
  HIDDEN VALLEY ROAD; A Neighborhood Compatibility Determination is requested for a
  single-story addition to an existing single-story house; A Minor Deviation is requested to
  decrease the front yard by less than 10%. A second Minor Deviation is requested for the
  single-story addition to be built along the existing building line that encroaches into a legal
  nonconforming setback.

  Senior Planner Naughton provided a summary of the staff report for Planning Application
  No. PA-09-19.

Minutes  1
Planning Commission Meeting, July 1, 2019
   Senior Planner Naughton stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission
  approve Planning Application PA-09-19, approving the Neighborhood Compatibility
  Determination, and the two requested Minor Deviations, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval outlined in the staff report.

  Nicholas Pribuss, 8 Hidden Valley Road, thanked their neighbors for their outreach and
  stated that he is in support of the process. However, he has concerns with privacy to the
  east and how the project will look from their property. He also asked if the pool deck could
  be relocated closer to the south or west.

  Gary Lane, Lane Design Build, stated that in the area in question, it will be a storage area
  with siding to match the house. There will be a shower which will have walls around it and
  will be designed in a way that will not be visible to the neighbors.

  Senior Planner Naughton stated that a fence could be installed exempt from building
  permit requirements. However, retaining walls over 3 feet be more involved. Prior to
  construction completion, a landscape plan is required.

  In response to a question by COMMISSION SCHACHTER, Senior Planner Naughton
  stated that a 5’ safety fence is required around pools.

  Planning Director Wahba stated that the landscape plan is meant for water efficiency
  purposes and encouraged the neighbors to work together to address any privacy issues.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCHACTHER, Planning Director Wahba
  stated that the code does not require a fence at the property line. There is only a
  requirement for the pool to have fencing.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN made a motion to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION PA-09-19, APPROVING THE
  NEIGHBORHOOD COMPATIBILITY DETERMINATION, AND THE TWO
  REQUESTED MINOR DEVIATIONS, SUBJECT TO THE CONDITIONS OF
  APPROVAL OUTLINED IN THE STAFF REPORT

  Ayes: SCHACHTER, MEDAWAR, ZIGRANG, CARMAN, YOO, EDLER
  Noes:
  Absent: SCOTT
  Abstain:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that there is a 20-day appeal period for this item.

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  None

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  None

  10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  Planning Director Wahba announced the following:

  •  Doug Prichard, City Manager will be retiring on July 8th.
  •  Andy Clark has retired
  •  Cynthia Morquecho has been hired as Community Services Supervisor.
  •  The Planning Department will now be known as the Community Development
  Department.
  •  As of July 9th, Greg Grammer will be the City Manager.
  •  As of July 9th, David Wahba will be Director of Community Development and
  Public Works.
